description: List cited domains by tag coverage, most cited first with citation counts: either the domains one custom source tag matches (tag ID), or, with untagged true, the domains no tag covers at all. Built-in tags (platform) and Owned/Competitor (entity) are refused as tag IDs: their membership is automatic and not listable; add or remove patterns on them instead. Start from untagged when asked which domains still need tags or which new tags to suggest.

tag_id.description: Custom tag ID from the listing tool. Built-in tags are refused. Omit and set untagged to list sources no tag covers.

untagged.description: true lists cited domains that carry no tag at all: not Owned, not Competitor, no built-in tag, no custom tag. Use this to find what still needs tagging; then propose adding hosts to a built-in tag or a new custom tag.

name: source_tags__get_sources
